scope: Reconcile the saved claim that the local AC1021 metric TABLE stops on types 16/92 against the current parser and exact pinned source.

source.provenance: Pre-existing local corpus input; not added to the repository.

implementation.observation: The current TABLE CadValue reader explicitly handles data type 16 as a 2D point (and 32 as a 3D point). It reaches a candidate flags/type pair 18137348/48 at body bit 278726 and another 18141444/48 at bit 312907.

trace.table: Both observed type-48 candidates are refused as unsupported, and each TABLE retains an incomplete content snapshot.
trace.strictOutput: Preflight later refuses at the unrelated FIELD/FIELDLIST serializer gate; no DXF is published.

authority.specification: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.99, pp. 241–242
authority.interpretation: 48 is not a documented CadValue data type. The very large adjacent format-flags values and absent source-matched payload spans mean these observations may result from an earlier cursor misalignment; they do not establish that the producer stores a valid type 48.

decision: This receipt is the pre-fallback diagnostic. The raw-RS parse saw candidate type 48 at two offsets. A bounded AC1021 text-cell mask-0x01 BitShort fallback now parses all 171 CadValues in both existing metric and imperial sources while marking the TABLE semantics incomplete. The candidate is not a support/output claim; resolve the ODA RS conflict independently. See docs/research/p5-ac1021-metric-table-bitshort-fallback-2026-11-09.json.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was added or changed. The trace and all outputs remain in /private/tmp.
